nodes.description: CTR9 is the scaffold of the PAF1 complex (with PAF1, LEO1, CDC73 and RTF1), which associates with RNA polymerase II. The patient variants are predicted to disrupt CTR9's local structure and interactions, and the two variants tested bound PAF1 more strongly than wild-type protein. Mutant CTR9 interfered with endogenous ctr9 function in zebrafish, which is why ClinGen suggests a dominant-negative mechanism; this has not been tested further.
